data.name: Haelah
data.gender_notes: Haelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-l-h' meaning 'to rise, to exalt, to be lofty'. The name Haelah refers to a woman of great stature and nobility, one who is revered and admired for her wisdom and grace. The name Haelah carries the meaning “Exalted, sublime” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haelah usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, sublime and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Haelah is also a reminder of the constant striving towards loftiness and transcendence that is at the heart of Islamic spirituality.
